title: Division One Basketball LLC Launches the Biggest Game of "HORSE" in America - $150K in Cash & Prizes Up for Grabs | User | ridgwayrecord.com
text:
Las Vegas, NV - March 12, 2025 - Division One Basketball LLC, founded by former Division One basketball players with an enduring passion for the game, is bringing the biggest game of "HORSE" in America to the national stage. This summer, the most creative and competitive hoopers in the country will battle for a staggering $150,000 prize pool in cash and prizes, proving their skills in the ultimate test of trick shots and precision.
This groundbreaking event will feature a series of nationwide challenges, leading up to an electrifying championship tournament in Las Vegas, Nevada. While the exact dates and venue are yet to be announced, one thing is certain: only the most inventive, precise, and consistent shooters will secure their place in the finals.
A New Era of Basketball Competition
Basketball has long been a game of fundamentals, athleticism, and skill, but "HORSE" elevates the sport to a new level, emphasizing creativity, precision, and showmanship. Unlike traditional competitions, where speed and strength often dominate, this event is about finesse, originality, and out-of-the-box thinking. Players will need to pull off jaw-dropping shots, mind-bending trick moves, and strategic play to outlast their competition.
Division One Basketball LLC, spearheaded by former elite college athletes, is committed to keeping the love of the game alive by fostering competitive and entertaining formats that showcase talent beyond traditional gameplay. "We wanted to create a platform where hoopers of all kinds could put their unique skills on display," said a spokesperson for Division One Basketball LLC. "This isn’t just a backyard contest—it’s a high-stakes showdown that will redefine basketball entertainment."
How to Enter
Participation is open to all basketball enthusiasts who believe they have what it takes to win. To enter, competitors must:
Follow @divisiononebasketball on Instagram.
Submit an edited video showcasing their best trick shots by sending a direct message (DM) on Instagram.
Once submitted, selected participants will be notified and given details on how to progress through the competition. With nationwide submissions pouring in, only the most skilled and innovative shooters will move on to the next stage.
The Road to Las Vegas
From the thousands of submissions, only a select few will rise to the top, earning a coveted spot in the championship tournament in Las Vegas. The final event promises to be a spectacle, bringing together top-tier trick shooters, influencers, and basketball lovers for an unforgettable showdown. Fans can expect a blend of high-energy performances, special guest appearances, and unparalleled excitement as contestants go head-to-head for the grand prize.
Are You Ready to Change the Game?
Think you have what it takes to outshoot the best? This summer, the game is evolving, and only the most creative and consistent players will make it to the top. Sharpen your skills, perfect your trick shots, and get ready to showcase your talent on a national stage.
For updates and more information, follow @divisiononebasketball on Instagram and stay tuned for official announcements.
